# larm_webhook_subscription (Resource)

Manages a Larm webhook subscription — an HTTPS endpoint that receives signed payloads when monitors change state.

**Notes:**

- **The signing secret is returned exactly once.** Terraform captures it on create and stores it in state. The Larm API does not expose secrets on read; if state loses the value, recreate the subscription to obtain a new one.
- **After `terraform import`, `secret` will be null.** Recreate the subscription if you need access to the signing secret.
- **Free-plan organizations cannot create subscriptions.** The API returns 403; upgrade the organization or use a different one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "larm_webhook_subscription" "ops" {
  url = "https://ops.example.com/larm-events"

  events = [
    "monitor.state_changed",
    "monitor.created",
    "monitor.deleted",
  ]
}

# Pass the signing secret to whatever needs to verify webhook signatures.
output "ops_signing_secret" {
  value     = larm_webhook_subscription.ops.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `events` (Set of String) Events the endpoint subscribes to. Allowed values: `monitor.state_changed`, `monitor.created`, `monitor.updated`, `monitor.deleted`.
- `url` (String) HTTPS endpoint that receives event payloads.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the subscription is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Webhook subscription ID.
- `inserted_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) HMAC-SHA256 signing secret. The API returns this only on create — preserved verbatim in state across reads and updates, and never re-fetchable.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 last-update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import larm_webhook_subscription.ops 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
